claims.claim_text: The indexed Emile R Counasse is a high-confidence match to the Army servicemember later documented as an OSS commissioned officer in France and Saigon.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Official and institutional sources preserve the rare full name across Army service, commissioned special-operations service and OSS Detachment 404.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from the rare exact name with middle initial, compatible rank progression and direct OSS context; Box 148 remains the controlling personnel-file check.
claims.temporal_assessment: The sources place Counasse in wartime special operations by May 1944 and with OSS Detachment 404 in September 1945; no pre-OSS employer is supplied.
claims.match_notes: The Department of Defense list records Sergeant, the Army history records Second Lieutenant, and the scholarly account records First Lieutenant; this is compatible with promotion.
